question: What actually changes inside a chatbot as you talk to it?
answer: Nothing in the model: its billions of numbers are fixed once training ends. Each reply is computed afresh from the whole conversation, resent by the app every turn; memory features store notes and paste them in. Past a length limit, early text is cut or summarised, which is why long chats lose their beginnings.
move: Seeming to remember can just mean rereading the whole file each time.
reference: Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 2020
